codeReview.summary: The feature adds substantial traceability tooling and reconciles memo table stats, but it does not satisfy two blocking requirements: enforcing parity/benchmark/memo single-commit lineage and validating clean-checkout reproducibility on the cited commit.

issues.description: Parity commit SHA is loaded (`parity_commit`) but never compared against memo/benchmark commits, so the check can pass even when parity artifacts are on a different commit. This violates the feature expectation of consistent lineage across parity, benchmark, and memo artifacts (features.json line 1696).

`check_reproducibility_package` only verifies file existence and does not execute a clean-checkout smoke reproduction of the cited commit. The feature explicitly requires clean-checkout reproducibility validation (features.json line 1698 and verification step line 1704).

Speedup claims are extracted and counted but not reconciled (`reconcile_speedups` returns an empty result and is never used), leaving narrative speedup statements effectively unchecked by the reconciliation gate.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The publication-worker procedure does not explicitly require running a clean-checkout smoke reproducibility run, even though mission guidance does.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/publication-worker/SKILL.md line 20 focuses on package completeness/traceable SHA; AGENTS.md line 29 requires a clean-checkout smoke reproducibility run.

sharedStateObservations.observation: There is no documented canonical method to bind publication-time parity artifacts to the same commit as measured benchmark evidence, and the worker treated parity commit drift as expected.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff line 93 states parity-artifacts/latest uses a different commit and that traceability check intentionally validates only measured benchmark commit consistency; publication/traceability_check.py line 109 reads parity commit but does not enforce match.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The skill/library guidance does not clearly state that IQR/CI reconciliation should use sampling_validation.json as authoritative computed statistics.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback line 100 requests this update explicitly; .factory/library/publication.md line 10 only states reconciliation against benchmark summary artifacts in general terms.

summary: Reviewed handoff, transcript skeleton, skill, shared-state docs, and commit 4141ea19f180b21e0c4379ed6eca9f9aa24db013. Result is FAIL due to blocking gaps in parity commit lineage enforcement and clean-checkout reproducibility validation; one additional non-blocking reconciliation coverage gap was noted.
